# Fuel50

> > Fuel50 is an AI-powered Talent Intelligence platform that enables organizations to ignite internal mobility, develop skills, and retain top talent through skills-based workforce strategies.

Fuel50 provides a comprehensive suite of products built on Skills Architecture and powered by I/O psychologists and people scientists. The platform combines skills intelligence, talent marketplaces, and analytics to help enterprises optimize workforce agility, succession planning, and employee development.

## Key Topics

- Skills Intelligence
- Talent Marketplace
- Internal Mobility
- Skills Architecture
- Workforce Planning
- Employee Retention
- Skills Ontology
- Talent Management
- Career Development
- Reskilling & Upskilling
- Succession Planning
- Workforce Agility
- Skills-Based Hiring
- Employee Engagement
- Talent Mobility

## Core Platform Products

- [Skills Intelligence Platform](https://fuel50.com/products/skills-intelligence): AI-powered talent insights and workforce analytics for skills-driven decision making
- [Talent Marketplace](https://fuel50.com/platform/talent-marketplace): AI-powered internal mobility and skills-based workforce matching platform
- [Skills Architecture](https://fuel50.com/products/skills-architecture): AI-driven workforce planning and talent blueprint optimization foundation
- [Skills Inventory](https://fuel50.com/products/skills-inventory): Transform talent management with comprehensive skills mapping and repositories
- [Fuel50 Insights](https://fuel50.com/products/insights): HR analytics for workforce strategy, succession planning, and talent insights

## Talent Development & Mobility Solutions

- [Mobility](https://fuel50.com/products/mobility): AI-powered internal hiring and career path matching for talent movement
- [Succession Planning](https://fuel50.com/products/succession): Skills-based succession planning and leadership pipeline development
- [Development Platform](https://fuel50.com/products/development): Personalized learning and career growth with integrated mentorship platform
- [Fuel50 Coach](https://fuel50.com/products/coach): Manager coaching at scale with skills development signals and guidance
- [Gigs Marketplace](https://fuel50.com/products/gigs): Skills-based internal talent marketplace for agile project-based staffing

## Strategic Workforce Solutions

- [Reskilling and Upskilling](https://fuel50.com/reskilling-and-upskilling): Strategic reskilling and upskilling programs using Skills Architecture and Talent Marketplace
- [Workforce Agility](https://fuel50.com/workforce-agility): Build workforce agility through skills-driven strategies and adaptive team models
- [Employee Retention & Engagement](https://fuel50.com/retention-and-engagement): Future-focused retention strategies through skills-first approach and career development
- [Learning and Growth](https://fuel50.com/learning-and-growth): Employee development strategies and career pathing for sustainable workforce growth
- [Talent Attraction](https://fuel50.com/talent-attraction): Skills-based hiring practices and internal mobility for talent attraction strategy
